recognize_zh: 三個畫面都是體積很大的巨噬細胞，細胞質內吞入十餘顆完整的有核細胞（多為小淋巴球）及紅血球，C 圖並含黑色色素顆粒；在發燒與全血球低下的 CLL 病人，符合噬血現象（hemophagocytosis）。
features: Very large macrophages with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm
Cytoplasm contains numerous engulfed intact nucleated cells, predominantly small round lymphocyte-like nuclei
Phagocytosed erythrocytes and dark pigment/debris in panel C
Panel A: the same phenomenon highlighted with a different (unspecified) stain showing red-brown ingested nuclei
Adjacent free small lymphocytes and red cells in the background
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show large macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous engulfed intact nucleated cells, predominantly small lymphocytes, as well as erythrocytes and pigmented debris. Panel A demonstrates a similar histiocyte with a different staining method. The ingested cells retain nuclear integrity rather than appearing as apoptotic fragments. Findings are consistent with hemophagocytosis; in a febrile, pancytopenic patient with CLL, correlation with HLH-2004 criteria (ferritin, triglycerides, fibrinogen, soluble CD25, organomegaly) and evaluation for infection are recommended.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris of varying size rather than intact whole cells.
In emperipolesis intact cells pass through megakaryocytes or Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes (S100-positive) without being degraded.
Overlapped cells lie in different focal planes and are not enclosed by a continuous macrophage cytoplasmic membrane.
Cannibalism is performed by atypical carcinoma or lymphoma cells rather than CD68/CD163-positive benign histiocytes.
